chunks: From him, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥakam, from Zakariyyā ibn al-Ḥurr, from Jābir ibn Yazīd, from Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
Indeed, the muʾmin is only afflicted in the world according to the measure of his religion—or he said: according to the degree of his religion.

key_terms.الْمُؤْمِنُ: the believer; the one possessing iman
key_terms.حَسَبِ: according to or in accordance with
key_terms.دِينِهِ: his religion; his state of religious commitment

ai.seo_question: How are a believer’s trials in this world related to the strength of his religion?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the afflictions a muʾmin faces in the world correspond to the measure and degree of his religion. It presents worldly trials as being proportionate to one’s dīn, highlighting the spiritual significance of tribulation in the life of the believer.
